headline: Reuters reports that drugmakers are putting more money into AI in the hope of cutting the cost and time it takes to develop new medicines.
score_reason: Reuters is a reliable outlet, but only the headline could be read, so score lowered by 1 as unverified.
importance_line: It points to more drug-industry spending on AI, which could in time affect how fast and how cheaply new medicines reach patients, but the scale of the spending and the companies involved are not known.
summary: Reuters reports that the pharmaceutical sector is doubling down on AI in hopes of cutting costs and shortening development timelines.
